answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in copper, expire in quill, and meadow lists each expiry. An adversary running 124 aliases thus needs 120 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2415 identities would post 4038 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
